official_definition: (Count Ultimate Trigger: Send a card from the opposing decktop to the Trash. If that card's cost is lower than the number of your counters, it's a hit.)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Count Ultimate Trigger] or [Count Ultimate Trigger: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Count Ultimate Trigger]", "give [Count Ultimate Trigger]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
